slides.headline: Three fixes, in shipping order

cards.title: Payment iframe
cards.detail: Swap the deprecated Safari handler for the current SDK. Recovers most of the 3,980 lost carts on its own.

cards.title: Session retry
cards.detail: Hold the cart when the token expires instead of dropping it. Customers stop losing their basket mid-payment.

cards.title: Error surface
cards.detail: Show the actual failure and a retry button. Today the screen goes blank and people leave.

slides.headline: Three weeks, one engineer
slides.subhead: Hold the autumn campaign until the fix ships. Spending on acquisition while checkout leaks costs us twice.
slides.notes: Ask plainly. Do not soften it. Then stop talking.
